key_values.event_name: 2019-2020 Australian smoke over the South Pacific
key_values.surface_proxy_scope: Surface proxy layers are used only as a comparison score against the upper-air transport ledger; they are not treated as proof of an event burn perimeter.

criteria.description: Returns exactly the requested eight-key compact JSON ledger with integer counts and the final label.
criteria.name: Ledger structure
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a mostly correct structure with one or two missing or renamed fields; no credit for prose-only output.

criteria.description: Computes 13 inclusive event days and a 2-day image-to-height lag.
criteria.name: Window and lag arithmetic
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for one correct value; award 1 point for traceable exclusive-date arithmetic.

criteria.description: Uses the 15-19 km smoke range, the 12 km threshold, and the 3 km minimum-height margin.
criteria.name: Altitude threshold test
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for using the right range but the wrong margin or threshold comparison.

criteria.description: Counts all six specified report signals and applies the at-least-5 pass rule.
criteria.name: Transport signal count
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for recognizing most signals but missing a paired wording test.

criteria.description: Computes transport_score = 4 from the duration, lag, altitude, and signal-count tests.
criteria.name: Transport score
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct component tests with an arithmetic or threshold error.

criteria.description: Computes surface_score = 1 from two failed surface proxy thresholds and the event-image date pass, while treating surface proxies as comparison evidence rather than burn-perimeter proof.
criteria.name: Surface comparison score
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for using the right proxy values but the wrong threshold outcome.

criteria.name: Gap and label
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for the right label with a wrong gap, or the right gap with an incorrect label.
